name: api_termination
expected: SIGKILL: restart policy restarts crm-api; healthy again
residual_risk: no in-flight request survives a kill; clients retry idempotently

name: worker_termination
expected: SIGKILL: worker restarts; durable claims recovered (R2 tests)
residual_risk: passes in flight are redone; covered by R2 claim/lease tests

name: postgres_unavailable
expected: worker unready (503, check_up=0) while the database is down; ready again after
residual_risk: crm-api readiness has no database check in this configuration (no surfaces opened); documented gap

name: wrong_environment
expected: worker declared production on a staging-attested database refuses to start
actual: exit=1 attestation failed: declared production but the database attests worker.environment.staging=true
residual_risk: relies on operators never attesting a disposable database as production

name: failed_migration
expected: crm-migrate stops at the first failing migration, non-zero exit, no credential in output; services gated on migrate never start
residual_risk: no automatic down-migration; recovery is restore + fix-forward

name: deployment_health_failure
expected: a misconfigured release fails --wait (non-zero); the previous configuration is restored healthy
residual_risk: stage.sh up reports FAILED; an operator decides to roll back

name: missing_secret
expected: a missing credential file refuses startup with the variable name only
residual_risk: none for startup; rotation procedure is documented, not automated

name: alert_condition_generated
expected: CRMUnexpectedFlagActivation condition (crm_worker_feature_flags_enabled > 1) becomes true, then clears
actual: before=1 during=2 after=1 (no Alertmanager: condition only, not a delivered page)
residual_risk: alert delivery and paging are NOT configured or verified

name: monitoring_unavailable
expected: no metrics scraper is deployed: the application is unaffected; detection relies on the CRMWatchdog dead-man's switch
residual_risk: monitoring pipeline and dead-man's switch delivery are NOT deployed (operator infrastructure)

name: disk_threshold_simulated
expected: free/size below 0.15 makes the CRMVolumeSpaceLow condition true
residual_risk: node exporter not deployed; condition evaluated by the drill, not by Prometheus

name: live_staging_backup_restore
expected: encrypted backup of the live staging database + evidence volume; verify; restore into a NEW crm_restore_* (quarantined); re-restore refused; live DB discard refused; drill copy discarded
actual: backup=0 verify=0 restore=0 status=COMPLETE recovery_s=2.507 rerestore_exit=2 discard_live_exit=2 discard_copy=0 credential_in_output=0
residual_risk: synthetic, tiny dataset: recovery time is NOT an RTO; host age binary mounted (Dockerfile.backup build NOT VERIFIED in this sandbox)

name: safe_cleanup
expected: destroy without CRM_STAGING_DESTROY=crm-staging is refused; unrelated volumes are never touched
residual_risk: destroy removes only this project's disposable-labelled volumes
